messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------------------|--------| | l'ora | “the hour” (temporal noun) | மணி | “hour” | OK | | del | genitive “of the” linking *ora* and *tempo* | நேரத்தின் | “of time” | OK | | tempo | “time” (noun) | நேரம் | “time” | OK | | e | coordinating “and” | மற்றும் | “and” | OK | | la (article) | definite article, feminine singular | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | dolce | adjective “sweet” | இனிய | “sweet” | OK | | stagione | noun “season” | காலம் | “season” | OK | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | ஆனால் | “but” | OK | | non (1st) | first negation in “non sì che” | அப்படியில்லை | “not so” (part of the whole) | OK | | sì | intensifier “so” in “non sì che” | அப்படியில்லை | “not so” (part of the whole) | OK | | che | subordinator “that” introducing clause | அது | “that/it” | OK | | paura | noun “fear” | பயத்தை | “fear” (object) | OK | | non (2nd) | second negation attached to the verb | அளிக்காத | “did not give” (negated verb) | OK | | mi | 1st‑person indirect object “to me” | எனக்கு | “to me” | OK | | desse | subjunctive “might give” (negated) | அளிக்காத | “did not give” | OK | | la (article, line 45) | definite article, feminine singular | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | vista | noun “sight, view” | காட்சி | “sight” | OK | | che (relative) | relative pronoun “which” | அது | “which/it” | OK | | m'apparve | verb “appeared to me” (subjunctive) | தோன்றியது | “appeared” | OK | | d'un | preposition + indefinite article “of a” | சிங்கத்தின் | “of the lion” (genitive) | OK | | leone | noun “lion” | சிங்கம் | “lion” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: the Italian definite article **la** appears twice (lines 43 and 45) but has no direct counterpart in Tamil; its omission is natural. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the current translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 43: - Original: நேரத்தின் மணி மற்றும் இனிய காலம்; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 44: - Original: ஆனால் அப்படியில்லை, அது எனக்கு பயத்தை அளிக்காத - Issue: internal punctuation (comma) and verb form; should be a single negative verb without comma - Corrected: ஆனால் அப்படியில்லை அது எனக்கு பயத்தை அளிக்காது - Line 45: - Original: சிங்கத்தின் காட்சி, அது எனக்கு தோன்றியது. - Issue: internal punctuation (comma) - Corrected: சிங்கத்தின் காட்சி அது எனக்கு தோன்றியது.
``` நேரத்தின் மணி மற்றும் இனிய காலம்; ஆனால் அப்படியில்லை அது எனக்கு பயத்தை அளிக்காது சிங்கத்தின் காட்சி அது எனக்கு தோன்றியது. ```
